senses.gloss: ch. same, [to scrape off; (cmp. חָנַךְ) to finish,]

units: Targ. II Chr. IV, 11.—חֲסִיל to be exhausted, gone.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 47:15">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLVII, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 31:24">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXI, 24</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 50:19">Targ. Y. II, Gen. L, 19</cite> <he>חַסְלַת וכ׳</he> the evil is paid off (atoned for; cmp. <he>גמל</he>).—Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ top <he>מן דַחֲסַל … מן וכ׳</he> when R. … had ceased from praying.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>, beg. <he>מן דחַסְלִין</he> (not <he>דמן ח׳</he>) when they had finished their studies; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 17:23">Targ. Y. II, Num. XVII, 23</cite> (h. text <he>גמל</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 1:24">Targ. I Sam. I, 24</cite> (h. text <he>גמל</he>); a. fr.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 46:18">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLVI, 18</cite>.—Y. Bicc. I, 64ᵃ <he>מְחַסֵּל לה</he> finished the sentence (by adding a general rule). Cant. R. beg. <he>זימנין מח׳ לה וכ׳</he> sometimes he goes through the entire alphabet &c.; (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:13:1">Koh. R. to I, 13</cite> <he>חשל</he>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 21:8">Targ. O. Gen. XXI, 8</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="H01769"><he>אִתְחַ׳</he></cite>); a. e.
